name: Monobeno -Happy End-
source:
After six years, [url=/c5502]Tooru[/url] returned with his younger sister [url=/c5499]Natsuha[/url] to the remote village of Monobeno deep in the mountains of Kochi prefecture. They reunited with the Akashaguma (child-like Yamori Youkai) [url=/c5500]Sumi[/url], the Kasayou [url=/c5567]Hishakaku[/url], and his childhood friend and self-proclaimed fiancée [url=/c5501]Alice[/url]. They played in the mountains, visited the shrine, and were visited by the Ushi Oni Tooko just like in the past.

Just as they were getting used to living in Monobeno, it was time for the Shichi Seisai summer festival dedicated to the local deity [url=/c5560]Himemiya[/url]-sama. The festival was lively, concluding with the masked dance. While watching the dancing, Natsuha suddenly started shaking, complaining that her body felt cold. Tooru quickly took her to [url=/c5563]Naotake[/url] — the doctor and Alice's father, but nothing seemed wrong with her. They went to play in the nearby stream the next day. Hearing the waterfall caused Natsuha to panic and run in fear, but they couldn't find a reason for her peculiar actions. That night, she appeared in front of them very much an adult, and she bled in her nether regions for the first time. Unable to figure out what caused these inexplicable changes, they could only calm her down and watch over her. Another shock awaited them in the morning when they found Natsuha had returned to her normal size but without any memories of the day before.

They decided to head back to the city for a proper examination. Unfortunately, a major landslide blocked off the only entrance to the village. Natsuha wished to leave badly, saying something scary was approaching her. What was causing Natsuha's changes? Was it a disease or a curse? Tooru was determined to find the cause and a way to save Natsuha.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

[url=/v12392]Monobeno -Happy End-[/url] is the remake of [url=/v8435]Monobeno[/url], with after stories for Sumi, Alice, Natsuha, and a pre-story for Hishakaku. It also rewrites parts of Sumi and Alice's route, which seem to be bad ends for Natsuha, and adds a toggle for certain CGs. Upon players' requests, the H-scenes are more numerous and intense. All in all, it's a happy ending for everyone.

In Sumi's after story, [spoiler]Tooru trains hard to turn back the clock for Natsuha[/spoiler] while supported by Sumi and their [spoiler]daughter [url=/c19059]Emi[/url], who has a unique ability to see ''holes'' which link the youkai world[/spoiler].

In Alice's after story, Tooru's happy life with Alice after fleeing the clutches of [spoiler]Himemiya-sama[/spoiler] is disrupted by the appearance of a young girl [url=/c22631]Seishin Himemiya[/url], who [spoiler]reverted Alice to a little girl and took her memories[/spoiler]. 

In Natsuha's after story, [spoiler]Natsuha remains in her small form, and Tooru aims to cure her completely[/spoiler].

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/10/21/october-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
六年后，[url=/c5502]透[/url]带着妹妹[url=/c5499]夏叶[/url]回到了高知县深山中的偏远村庄——物部。他们与赤鬼（孩童般的守宫妖怪）[url=/c5500]墨[/url]、笠原[url=/c5567]百角[/url]、以及青梅竹马兼自称未婚妻的[url=/c5501]爱丽丝[/url]重逢了。他们在山中玩耍、参拜神社、像过去一样被牛鬼桃花造访。

就在他们逐渐习惯物部的生活时，供奉当地神明[url=/c5560]姬宫[/url]大人的七圣祭夏日祭典到了。祭典热闹非凡，以面具舞蹈收场。观看舞蹈时，夏叶突然开始发抖，抱怨身体发冷。透赶紧带她去找[url=/c5563]直武[/url]——医生兼爱丽丝的父亲，但她似乎没什么问题。第二天他们去附近的溪流玩耍。听到瀑布声让夏叶惊恐地逃跑了，但他们找不到她异常行为的原因。那天晚上，她以成人的模样出现在他们面前，并且第一次来了月经。无法弄清这些不可思议变化的原因，他们只能安抚她并守护着她。第二天早上又一个震惊等待着他们——夏叶恢复了正常大小，但对前一天的事毫无记忆。

他们决定回城去做正规检查。不幸的是，一场大规模山体滑坡堵住了村庄的唯一入口。夏叶急切地想离开，说有什么可怕的东西在逼近她。是什么导致了夏叶的变化？是疾病还是诅咒？透决心找到原因和拯救夏叶的方法。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

[url=/v12392]《物部 -Happy End-》[/url]是[url=/v8435]《物部》[/url]的重制版，追加了墨、爱丽丝、夏叶的后日谈以及百角的前日谈。它还重写了墨和爱丽丝路线中对夏叶来说是坏结局的部分，并为某些CG添加了开关选项。应玩家要求，H场景更加丰富和激烈。总的来说，这是一个皆大欢喜的结局。

在墨的后日谈中，[spoiler]透为了夏叶拼命修炼，试图逆转时光[/spoiler]，在墨和她们的[spoiler]女儿[url=/c19059]惠美[/url]的支持下——她拥有看到连接妖怪世界“孔洞”的独特能力[/spoiler]。

在爱丽丝的后日谈中，透与爱丽丝在逃离[spoiler]姬宫大人[/spoiler]的魔掌后幸福的生活，被一个名叫[url=/c22631]星神姬宫[/url]的少女的出现所打断，她[spoiler]将爱丽丝变回了小女孩并夺走了她的记忆[/spoiler]。

在夏叶的后日谈中，[spoiler]夏叶保持着小小的形态，透的目标是将她完全治愈[/spoiler]。

[编辑自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/10/21/october-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
